name: pptx-toolkit
description: deck-spec.json → 편집 가능한 전문 PPTX (정부·컨설팅·제안서 프로파일) — Claude 스킬 겸 CLI

scripts.build:examples: mkdir -p build && node scripts/build.js examples/consulting-kiosk-strategy.spec.json -o build/consulting.pptx && node scripts/build.js examples/gov-ai-platform-briefing.spec.json -o build/gov.pptx && node scripts/build.js examples/proposal-shipyard-ax.spec.json -o build/proposal.pptx --hooks examples/proposal-hooks.js && node scripts/build.js examples/archetype-showcase.spec.json -o build/showcase.pptx
